verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭਾ ਦੁਸਾਸਣੈ ਮਥੇਵਾਲਿ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਆਂਦੀ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)dhar sabhaa dhusaasanai mathevaal dhropatee aa(n)dhee|

en.bdb: Dragging Daropati by the hair, Dusasanai brought her into the assembly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਤਾ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਨੰਗੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਪੰਚਾਲੀ ਬਾਂਦੀ।
verses.translit_en: dhootaa no furamaiaa na(n)gee karahu pa(n)chaalee baa(n)dhee|

en.bdb: He commanded his men to strip the maidservant Dropati stark naked.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜੇ ਪਾਂਡੋ ਵੇਖਦੇ ਅਉਘਟਿ ਰੁਧੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਦੀ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)je paa(n)ddo vekhadhe aaughaT rudhee naar jinaa dhee|

en.bdb: All the five Pandavs who she was the wife of, beheld this.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਹਾ ਹਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਂਦੀ।
verses.translit_en: akhee meeT dhiaan dhar haa haa kirasan karai bilalaa(n)dhee|

en.bdb: Crying, totally dejected and helpless, she closed her eyes. Single-mindedly she invoked Krishna for help.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਪੜ ਕੋਟੁ ਉਸਾਰਿਓਨੁ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਵਸਾਂਦੀ।
verses.translit_en: kapaR koT usaarion thake dhoot na paar vasaa(n)dhee|

en.bdb: The servants were taking off the clothes from her body but more layers of clothes formed a fort around her; the servants got tired but the layers of clothes were never ending.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਥ ਮਰੋੜਨਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਧੁਣਨਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਨਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜਾਂਦੀ।
verses.translit_en: hath maroRan sir dhunan pachhotaan karan jaeh jaa(n)dhee|

en.bdb: The servants were now writhing and frustrated on their abortive attempt and felt that they themselves were ashamed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਆਈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਪੈਜ ਰਹੀ ਬੋਲੇ ਸ਼ਰਮਾਂਦੀ।
verses.translit_en: ghar aaiee Thaakur mile paij rahee bole sharamaa(n)dhee|

en.bdb: On reaching home, Dropati was asked by Lord Krishna whether she was saved in the assembly.
She shyly replied, “Since perennial times you are living up to your reputation of being father of the fatherless ones.”
